task: FORENSIC import-velocity pull to impute whether Evolus (EOLS) is pre-buying/stockpiling Jeuveau (Nabota/DWP-450) inventory ahead of the 15% US tariff on South-Korean goods effective 2026-09-29
verdict: INCONCLUSIVE on the targeted customs channel (US ocean BOL is structurally BLIND to this trade); CORROBORATING channel (Daewoong Korean disclosures) shows NO surge through Q1 2026 and is consistent with FLAT / NO-stockpile-yet, but the decisive Q2-Q3 2026 window is NOT YET REPORTED.
confidence: MEDIUM on the no-surge-yet read through Q1-2026; LOW on Q2-2026 because no data point exists yet for the quarter that matters most.

entity_resolution.shipper_consignee_relationship: Daewoong Pharmaceutical Co Ltd (Hwaseong/Incheon, South Korea) manufactures Nabota / DWP-450 (botulinum toxin type A) and supplies it to Evolus Inc (Newport Beach, CA) under an exclusive US license; US brand = Jeuveau.
entity_resolution.verified_relationship_source: Evolus/Daewoong license + supply agreement (EDGAR S-1 exhibit 10.3, SEC.gov), ITC 337-1145 (Daewoong manufactures and supplies Jeuveau to Evolus from a constructed S. Korea facility)

customs_channel_result.structural_blind_spot: DECISIVE. US public bill-of-lading data (CBP Automated Manifest System FOIA feed) that ImportYeti / ImportGenius / Panjiva / Volza / Trademo are ALL built on covers VESSEL/OCEAN manifests ONLY. Air cargo is excluded from the public CBP manifest dataset. Jeuveau/Nabota is a refrigerated 2-8C cold-chain lyophilized biologic shipped in small high-value vials (FDA label: store 2-8C, do not freeze; ~vial-scale, multi-million-dollar consignments per kg). Such pharma moves by AIR freight (Incheon -> US, Korean Air Cargo / UPS pharma cold-chain terminal at ICN), NOT ocean container. Therefore a real Daewoong->Evolus stockpile would generate FEW-TO-ZERO public ocean BOL records regardless of magnitude. Absence of ocean BOL records is NOT evidence of no stockpile; the channel simply cannot see this trade.

aggregators_attempted.importyeti: BLOCKED. /company/ route is Cloudflare JS-challenge protected (403 / 'Just a moment'); backend data.importyeti.com/v1.0/company/<slug> returns 401 Unauthorized (token issued at page load, gated to paid/free-tier auth); search route is client-rendered (results load via gated XHR). Full browser fingerprint curl also 403.
aggregators_attempted.importgenius: Free tier gives directory listing only; granular Evolus<-Daewoong shipment records are paywalled.

customs_channel_result.note: No fabricated shipments. Zero verifiable per-month/per-quarter Daewoong->Evolus ocean BOL rows were extractable from any free aggregator. This is a coverage failure (paywall + Cloudflare) COMPOUNDED by a structural mode mismatch (air vs ocean), not a confirmed zero.

corroboration_channel_daewoong_disclosur.status: VERIFIED (Daewoong quarterly/annual Nabota figures, KRW) — this is the usable proxy time series for Daewoong->US export VELOCITY
corroboration_channel_daewoong_disclosur.note_units: Korean press uses 억원 (= 0.1 billion KRW = 100 million KRW). Figures below normalized to KRW billion. Nabota total = Korea + all exports; US/Evolus is the dominant export slice (~70% of exports historically). Use the EXPORT line as the US-velocity proxy.

nabota_time_series_krw_billion.Q2_2026: NOT YET REPORTED (quarter not closed; Daewoong Q2 report ~mid-Aug 2026) — THE decisive datapoint is missing

corroboration_channel_daewoong_disclosur.velocity_read: Daewoong Nabota total grew ~14% YoY in Q1 2026 — a DECELERATION from the ~25-32% YoY pace of 2024-H1'2025. Exports were 82% of sales in Q1'26 vs 85% in H1'25. A pre-tariff US stockpile would show Daewoong's US-bound exports SPIKING (well above trend) in Q2-Q3 2026; through Q1 2026 there is NO such spike — if anything growth is moderating. This is consistent with FLAT / no-stockpile-yet, NOT a surge.
corroboration_channel_daewoong_disclosur.daewoong_management_statement: On tariff pre-shipment, Daewoong stated 'no specifically confirmed details have been determined yet' and that its mitigation approach is SUPPLY DIVERSIFICATION (공급다변화로 선제 대응 — Middle East/LatAm/China expansion), NOT US inventory pre-buying. No disclosed acceleration of US shipments. (paxetv 238564; topdaily 104900)

evolus_balance_sheet_corroboration.note: EOLS InventoryNet (SEC XBRL) is the direct on-the-books check and AGREES with the no-surge-yet read.
evolus_balance_sheet_corroboration.read: The big 2025 build ($10M->$33M) PRE-DATES the 2026-04-02 tariff proclamation -> launch/demand-driven, not tariff-stockpiling, and reversed to ~$25M (~3 months cover) by Mar-2026 = normal operating level. Any genuine tariff stockpile is a Q2-Q3 2026 event NOT yet on any filed balance sheet (Q2 10-Q files ~early Aug). EOLS 10-Q states qualitative intent only ('proactively managing inventory flows into the United States to protect against such tariffs') — no quantified plan; words 'stockpile'/'pre-import' appear zero times.

read: FLAT / NO STOCKPILE DEMONSTRATED YET (through Q1 2026), with the caveat that the customs channel is structurally blind and the decisive Q2-Q3 2026 window has not yet printed in any source. NOT a SURGE.
caveats: MODE MISMATCH (primary): US public BOL = ocean only; this cold-chain biologic ships by AIR -> the targeted customs-velocity method cannot see the trade. This is the controlling limitation, beyond mere aggregator paywalls.
AGGREGATOR COVERAGE: ImportYeti/Genius/Volza/Trademo/Panjiva free tiers all blocked (Cloudflare 403 / 401 token-gated / paywalled); no shipment rows extracted. Do not read absence as zero.
EU-vs-US BLIND SPOT generalized: just as EU intra-bloc and air shipments are invisible to US CBP manifests, Korea->US air pharma is invisible too.
MASKING: pharma BOL value/description is routinely masked even when ocean rows exist; count+weight fallback is itself unavailable here.

TIMING: the stockpile, if it happens, is a Q2-Q3 2026 phenomenon (ahead of 2026-09-29). As of 2026-06-26 it is unobservable in customs, in Daewoong disclosures, and on EOLS's last filed (Mar-2026) balance sheet. The honest answer is 'too early + wrong channel,' not 'confirmed flat.'
best_observable_watch_items: EOLS Q2 2026 10-Q (~early Aug): InventoryNet must break ABOVE ~$33M / 4 months cover to signal a real pre-tariff build. This is the cleanest, most authoritative stockpile tell — beats customs.
Daewoong Q2 2026 report (~mid-Aug): a Nabota US/export line jumping well above the ~14% YoY Q1 trend would corroborate a Daewoong-side pre-ship to Evolus.

Korea Customs Service HS 3002 (botulinum/biologics) export-to-US monthly stats for Apr-Sep 2026: a 2026 monthly spike vs 2024-25 baseline would be the macro confirm (not pulled here; tradedata.go.kr / KITA is the source, often month-lagged).
EOLS 10-Q working-capital line: inventory swinging from a +$6.4M Q1 SOURCE to a large USE of cash = the build starting.
